records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended March 31, 2025 decreased $3.3 million, or 3.9%, to $82.1 million from $85.4 million in the three months ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2025 was primarily due to lower volume of pounds sold offset by higher pricing compared to the prior period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of March 31, 2025, the Company had committed to purchase green coffee inventory totaling $56.0 million under fixed-price contracts, and $11.4 million in inventory and other purchases under non-cancelable purchase orders.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net sales for the nine months ended March 31, 2025 was primarily due to higher pricing compared to the prior period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities during the nine months ended March 31, 2025 was $6.4 million as compared to net cash used in operating activities of $13.2 million in the nine months ended March 31, 2024, an increase in cash provided by operations of $19.5 million.
